# FDG8037

> DO NOT inherit from non-generic base collections such as `CollectionBase`. Use `Collection<T>`, `ReadOnlyCollection<T>`, and `KeyedCollection<TKey,TItem>` instead.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.3.4 Implementing Custom Collections.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1058
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

The text has no body. CA1058 reports a type derived from CollectionBase, ReadOnlyCollectionBase or DictionaryBase and names the generic replacement (probe with SDK 10.0.402); a type derived from ArrayList or Hashtable was not reported, so coverage is partial. CA1058 also reports types derived from ApplicationException (FDG7040) and XmlDocument (FDG8098). Changing the base type of a public type changes its public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1058 has no code fix.
